_comment: RCCL per-PR perf-regression detection. Ref+cand both use _fixed/lib (rebuilt 2026-07-14 from rocm-systems develop HEAD 8a7d08d925 -- fixes gfx950 DDA alltoall segfault, large-message (>=1G) alltoall OOB/abort/hang, and alltoall bfloat16 correctness bug). BUILD_RCCL=1 overwrites reference/candidate in-allocation for PRs touching projects/rccl. alltoall_perf re-enabled (removed from skip_keys); RCCL_DDA_ENABLE override removed from ainic_rccl_env.sh. | UPDATE 2026-07-13: alltoall correctness bugs (DDA segfault c59673fc, bf16 correctness, large-msg >=1G OOB/abort/hang) confirmed FIXED on develop HEAD 8a7d08d925 -- lib rebuilt/repinned, RCCL_DDA_ENABLE override removed from ainic_rccl_env.sh entirely. HOWEVER control-mode calibration (job 12389, 2026-07-13) revealed alltoall_perf has severe reproducible large-message (128MB-4G) PERFORMANCE INSTABILITY (up to ~5-6x swings between identical A=A repeats), unique among the 5 gated collectives (others show <1 pct variance at same sizes); boundary aligns exactly with the 64MB DDA_THRESHOLD, suggesting a separate still-present perf bug in the alltoall large-message non-DDA path, independent of the fixed correctness bugs. Config has no per-collective threshold override, so including alltoall in the shared large tier pool inflated the derived threshold ~60-100x (0.126 -> 8.41), which would blind the gate to real large-message regressions in ALL 5 collectives. Decision: alltoall_perf stays in rccl_collective (runs, for visibility) but is skip_keys out of ab_regression comparison/gating until root-caused or per-collective thresholds are implemented. See CI_PIPELINE_PLAN.md for full writeup. | Static thresholds fallback refreshed 2026-07-14 from job 12455 control-mode recalibration (4 collectives, alltoall excluded) -- use_derived_thresholds is True by default so ab_derived_thresholds.json is the live source of truth at detect time; this field is only the fallback if that file is ever missing.
